name: Conjure Constructs

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Place intangible Construct spirits within 60 feet. On casting and later Magic actions, choose a target within 5 feet of them: Dexterity save against 3d6 Force (half on success), or 1d6 + spellcasting modifier Temporary HP. Move the spirits up to 30 feet when moving on your turn. Both dice totals gain 1d6 per slot above 3.
